name: non_transitive_dice_m6_n5_seed6965__v1_nh
prompt:
Design 5 cyclically intransitive dice, each with 6 faces showing values in {0, ..., 11}. The dice must satisfy: die i 'beats' die (i+1) mod 5 in head-to-head face comparison — i.e., for every i in [0, 5): #{(a,b) : face(i,a) > face((i+1) mod 5,b)} > 18, out of 36 possible (a,b) face pairs. Famous problem (Efron's dice).

Return a flat list of 30 integers: entry i*6+j is the j-th face value (0-indexed) of die i (faces sorted ascending). State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such dice exist.
